headline: Leidos Beats Q3 EPS Forecasts But Shares Fall
summary: Leidos reported third-quarter earnings per share that topped analyst forecasts, though its shares declined following the release.
why: Leidos is a major defense and technology contractor for the US government, making its financial performance an indicator of federal IT and defense spending trends.

impacts.name: Leidos
impacts.why: Despite beating EPS forecasts, profit-taking or broader market sentiment caused shares to drop.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Shares fell despite better-than-expected earnings per share due to profit-taking or valuation pressures.
